# Vendored ROS 2 message provenance

`actuation_module/src/autoware/autoware_msgs/msg_ros/` holds upstream
ROS 2 Humble `.msg` files vendored verbatim from their source repos for
the nano-ros migration (Phase 1B). This file is the audit ledger.

**Do not hand-edit the data rows.** Generated by `scripts/sync_msg_ros.sh`.
Re-run that script after bumping any pin in its `PACKAGES` table; copy
the SHA report it prints back here.

## Why we vendor

- **Hermetic cross-build.** Zephyr cross-compile for FVP / S32Z R52
  cannot rely on a system ROS install (`/opt/ros/humble/share`) being
  present in the dev container's cross sysroot.
- **Single audit point.** Drift vs upstream Humble shows up in code
  review when the table below changes.
- **Maintainer-controlled.** The sync script is run only when bumping
  a pin, not in CI. CI consumes the checked-in tree.

## Per-package file inventory

Only the `.msg` files transitively reachable from the ASI live
controller I/O are vendored. Adding a new field that pulls a new type
means adding the file here, then re-running the sync script.

- **builtin_interfaces** — `Time.msg`, `Duration.msg`
- **std_msgs** — `Header.msg`
- **geometry_msgs** — `Point.msg`, `Vector3.msg`, `Quaternion.msg`,
  `Pose.msg`, `PoseStamped.msg`, `PoseArray.msg`, `PoseWithCovariance.msg`,
  `PoseWithCovarianceStamped.msg`, `Twist.msg`, `TwistStamped.msg`,
  `TwistWithCovariance.msg`, `TwistWithCovarianceStamped.msg`,
  `Accel.msg`, `AccelStamped.msg`, `AccelWithCovariance.msg`,
  `AccelWithCovarianceStamped.msg`, `Transform.msg`, `TransformStamped.msg`,
  `QuaternionStamped.msg`, `Vector3Stamped.msg`
- **nav_msgs** — `Odometry.msg`
- **autoware_perception_msgs** — `PredictedPath.msg`
- **autoware_vehicle_msgs** — `SteeringReport.msg`, `VelocityReport.msg`
- **autoware_planning_msgs** — `Trajectory.msg` (patched, see below),
  `TrajectoryPoint.msg`, `Path.msg`, `PathPoint.msg`
- **autoware_control_msgs** — `Control.msg`, `Lateral.msg`,
  `Longitudinal.msg`, `ControlHorizon.msg`
- **autoware_adapi_v1_msgs** — `OperationModeState.msg` (lives under
  upstream `operation_mode/msg/`; flattened to `msg/` on vendor side)
- **tier4_debug_msgs** — `Float32Stamped.msg`, `Float64Stamped.msg`,
  `Float32MultiArrayStamped.msg`, `Float64MultiArrayStamped.msg`,
  `MultiArrayLayout.msg`, `MultiArrayDimension.msg`,
  `ProcessingTimeNode.msg`, `ProcessingTimeTree.msg`

## ASI-local patches

Applied automatically by `scripts/sync_msg_ros.sh` after fetch:

- `autoware_planning_msgs/msg/Trajectory.msg` — `points` bounded to
  `autoware_planning_msgs/TrajectoryPoint[<=250]`. ASI's controller
  reserves exactly 250 points; the upstream unbounded sequence does not
  fit nano-ros's static-allocation model. nano-ros's `rosidl-parser`
  accepts `[<=N]` per REP-2004.

## ASI-local helper types (NOT vendored)

These appear in the current ASI `.idl` set but have no clean upstream
home. Leave them in `actuation_module/src/autoware/autoware_msgs/msg/`
under their existing `.idl` form for now — they don't go through
nros codegen.

- `Float32.msg`, `Float64.msg` — local scalar helpers
- `VelocityStamped.msg` — origin unclear; module owners to confirm

## Licenses

All vendored packages are Apache-2.0; compatible with ASI's Apache-2.0
license. The full upstream LICENSE files live in each source repo at
the pinned SHA — not duplicated here.

## How to bump a pin

```
# Edit the relevant row in scripts/sync_msg_ros.sh's PACKAGES table
# (change tag/branch column).
./scripts/sync_msg_ros.sh
# Inspect the staged diff under msg_ros/, then update the SHA column
# in this file from the script's stdout report.
git add actuation_module/src/autoware/autoware_msgs/msg_ros/ docs/MSG_PROVENANCE.md
git commit -m "chore(msgs): bump <package> to <tag>"
```
